propositions.proposition: Meridian Energy Partners invoices are described as the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
propositions.relevance: Associates Meridian Energy Partners billing activity with the MSA-MER-2024 agreement, but does not by itself establish that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC is the same legal counterparty as the contract referent.

propositions.proposition: The billed name on record is Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent (billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC) as the entity name used in billing records.

propositions.proposition: MSA-MER-2024 is an advisory retainer agreement whose counterparty is Meridian Energy Partners LLC, effective 2 February 2024, with a 12-month initial term then month-to-month.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent (contract:MSA-MER-2024) and names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as the agreement counterparty; name correspondence alone does not establish identity between the billing referent and the contract referent.

propositions.proposition: MSA-MER-2024 restricts assignment by Meridian Energy Partners LLC, including a prohibition on assignment to a competitor of the provider.
propositions.relevance: Further describes obligations of the named contract counterparty Meridian Energy Partners LLC but does not link that party to the billing referent with establishing identity evidence.
